descriptor: Message delivery API for email, SMS and webhooks

voice.summary: Relay writes like good API documentation with a sense of humour: exact about behaviour, brief about everything else and happy to show a request rather than describe one. Marketing lines stay short and concrete.
dos: Show real endpoints, status codes and latencies
Prefer code and numbers to adjectives
Keep headlines to one blunt idea
donts: Describe an API without showing a request

taglines: Send it. Trace it. Forget it
boilerplate: Relay is a developer API for sending email, SMS and webhooks through one interface, with automatic retries, tracing and per-message logs included in every plan.

microcopy.error: Request failed with 401. Check your API key.
microcopy.empty: No messages yet. Send your first request.

logo.note: A forward arrow-like chevron matches the arrow in the page's own wordmark and the idea of passing messages along.
